about: Washing and sterilization cycles: program, configure, load, unload, start (job), stop, pause, open/close (door / lid), status. power, ack, estop come from the shared layer.

not_mapped.elma_elmasonics60h: ultrasonic cleaning bath: its cleaning is sonication with heat (agitation primary, thermal secondary); no programme object
not_mapped.biotek_405ts: plate washer: its wash programmes belong to the bioassay class (primary) with plate handling

not_here.temp: the temperatures are fixed in the programme blocks (customer programmes: `chemlab call INST programmes.set_block`)
not_here.time: the hold times are fixed in the programme blocks (customer programmes: `chemlab call INST programmes.set_block`)

pause:on.message: no programme is running on {inst} (it is {value}).

pause:off.message: the programme of {inst} is not interrupted (it is {value}).

open:door.message: the door of {inst} stays locked while a programme is {value} (also when interrupted).
open:door.fix: wait until it has ended (`chemlab run {inst} status`), or cancel it first: `chemlab run {inst} stop`.
open:door.label: no programme active

close:door.message: the lower basket of {inst} is pulled out; the door does not close over it.
close:door.fix: push it in: `chemlab call {inst} basket.set_position --slot lower --extension_m 0`.
close:door.label: lower basket in

unsupported.load: glassware goes into its baskets by hand (the operator); the twin has no item ledger (baskets: `chemlab call INST basket.set_position`)
unsupported.unload: glassware is taken out of its baskets by hand (the operator)

start: start returns job-N; the door locks until the programme has ended; `chemlab wait job-N` or --wait blocks (a programme takes about 30-90 min)
configure: only drying=on|off can be changed from the computer for the standard programmes
pause: pause on interrupts (the current wash block is repeated on resume); pause off resumes

not_here.drying: drying times are custom-program parameters (`chemlab call INST program.set_parameters`)

open:lid.message: the pressure lock of {inst} is engaged: a cycle runs, or the chamber is under pressure or above its end temperature.
open:lid.fix: wait until the cycle has ended and the chamber has cooled (`chemlab run {inst} status`), then open.
open:lid.label: lid not locked

unsupported.pause: no pause: the start/stop key aborts a running cycle (`stop`)

alternatives.pause: stop it with `chemlab run INST stop` (the cycle ends as failed) and start a new one later.

configure: only custom_1, custom_2 and extended_time can be edited: temp=121C..138C, time=, exhaust=fast|slow_liquids|slow_waste|cooling, end_temp=
load: loads go in with the lid open; liquids need --liquid and --volume (container); biological indicators: --organism and --log10
start: start returns job-N (a cycle takes about 20-60 min of lab time); the lid stays locked until the chamber is depressurised and cooled
